create_MiMoMTP_model: create a MiMoMTP model instance for multi-token prediction with config and quantization
build_MiMoMultiTokenPredictorLayer: build a MiMoMultiTokenPredictorLayer with config, prefix, and optional quantization config
run_MiMoMTP_forward: run MiMoMTP forward pass with input_ids, positions, and forward_batch to produce logits
refactor_MiMoMTP_load_weights: refactor MiMoMTP load_weights to map and shard checkpoint weights into model parameters
review_MiMoMTP_map_model_name: review MiMoMTP map_model_name_to_mtp_param_name to remap checkpoint param names to MTP layer names
